description: A Java test class for testing backdated disbursement scenarios of loan accounts in the Apache Fineract project. It includes multiple test cases verifying behavior with different configurations of disbursement dates, schedule start types, and down payment settings.

classes.name: LoanAccountBackdatedDisbursementTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseLoanIntegrationTest for testing various backdated disbursement scenarios, schedule adjustments, validation errors, and configuration variations related to loans in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the REST request and response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: loanAccountBackDatedDisbursementForLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentAndScheduleStartDateTypeAsDisbursementDateTest
methods.description: Test case for a loan with down payment enabled and schedule start date type as disbursement date, verifying repayment schedule and disbursement behavior.

methods.name: loanAccountBackDatedDisbursementForLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentAndScheduleStartDateTypeAsSubmittedOnDateTest
methods.description: Test case for a loan with down payment enabled and schedule start date based on submitted date, verifying repayment schedule and disbursement behavior.

methods.name: loanAccountBackDatedDisbursementAfterTwoRepaymentsForLoanProductWithEnableDownPaymentAndScheduleStartDateTypeAsDisbursementDateTest
methods.description: Verifies schedule updates after multiple repayments and backdated disbursements with disbursement date as disbursement date type.

methods.name: loanAccountBackDatedDisbursementWithDisbursementDateBeforeLoanSubmittedOnDateValidationTest
methods.description: Validates that errors are thrown when attempting to disburse before the submitted date of the loan.

methods.name: loanAccountBackDatedDisbursementForLoanProductWithDisableDownPaymentAndScheduleStartDateTypeAsDisbursementDate_DisbursementPeriodsOrderTest
methods.description: Tests disbursement behavior with down payment disabled and schedule start type as disbursement date—specifically the periods order and schedule adjustments.
